verdict_rule.FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP: Observed candidate proof DAG grows materially relative to compact reference under the frozen empirical criterion; not a lower bound.
verdict_rule.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Frozen resource budget exhausted before a classified blind result.
